cues: Three things the board always asks.
It lowers the barrier by the same amount in both directions, so forward and backward reactions speed up equally, and the position of equilibrium does not change.
Only the time to reach it does.
Delta H is unchanged, because the start and finish levels are the same.
And a catalyst cannot make an impossible reaction happen.
